reuse.why: Routes the new flag through the existing getMonthWideActionCategories selection used by every month-wide action instead of adding per-action checks.

duplication.why: The hidden rule changes once, in the shared SQL; actions only forward the flag through a shared MonthWideActionArgs type.

placement.why: The exclusion change sits in the category-selection helper in budget/actions.ts, where the other month-wide exclusions already live.

scope.why: Only the selection helper, the six actions' signatures, tests and a release note change.

maintainability.why: One parameter on one helper with a defaulted false and a shared args type is easy to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions, including copyPreviousMonth, take eligibility from getMonthWideActionCategories.
